authentication.authenticated_behavior: Use a read-only token, include is:public in every search, and reject any repository detail whose visibility is not public.
authentication.credential_capture: never record token value, authorization header, or credential-derived private response
authentication.unauthenticated_behavior: Fail before any request with GITHUB_QUERY_AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE; do not partially execute direct-PR queries.

candidate_materialization.candidate_unit: one merged pull request in one public canonical GitHub repository
candidate_materialization.direct_pr_result: resolve through required repository and PR-detail captures
candidate_materialization.issue_result: discovery lead only; resolve every closing PR through the complete closedByPullRequestsReferences connection, retain merged=true nodes, and then obtain the same required REST repository and PR-detail captures

automatic_keys: same repository numeric ID plus same PR number
same repository numeric ID plus same merge_commit_sha
issue-resolved PR merge_commit_sha equal to an explicit repair commit in the same repository
deduplication.direct_pr_and_issue_lead: collapse only on the automatic positive keys and retain every query/source-record provenance
deduplication.github_node_id_role: source-native identity only, never canonical candidate identity
deduplication.missing_key_behavior: never wildcard-match; SOURCE_REJECTED if PR materialization fields are missing

issue_resolution.graphql_document: query ClosingPullRequests($owner: String!, $repository: String!, $number: Int!, $cursor: String) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $repository) { databaseId nameWithOwner url visibility issue(number: $number) { id number closedByPullRequestsReferences(first: 100, after: $cursor) { nodes { id number merged mergedAt baseRefOid headRefOid mergeCommit { oid } repository { databaseId nameWithOwner url visibility } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } } }
issue_resolution.node_filter: merged is exactly true; null nodes or missing required fields reject the issue source record
issue_resolution.pagination: start cursor null; capture every page in returned connection order; continue with exact endCursor while hasNextPage=true
issue_resolution.relation: closedByPullRequestsReferences only; no title, body, URL, branch-name, or commit-message heuristic

pagination.count_consistency: every page must report the first page's exact total_count; drift fails the query closed
pagination.import_rule: after all pages validate, account for every item from pages 1 through expected_pages; source-record IDs and candidate IDs are independent of tie order
pagination.incomplete_results_true: fail the entire query closed; encountered items receive SOURCE_REJECTED:GITHUB_SEARCH_INCOMPLETE_RESULTS and no candidate is materialized
pagination.total_count_over_cap: fail the entire query closed; encountered items receive SOURCE_REJECTED:GITHUB_SEARCH_RESULT_CAP_EXCEEDED; prospective date sharding requires a later committed amendment before another request

raw_capture.capture_transaction: one query at one UTC start time with no retry or query mutation inside the transaction
raw_capture.pr_detail: capture exact response bytes, request URL and parameters, UTC time, HTTP status, selected API version, response headers, and SHA-256
raw_capture.repository_detail: capture exact response bytes and SHA-256 including numeric ID and public visibility
required_for_every_response: query ID and page or cursor
raw_capture.search_page: capture even when incomplete_results=true or total_count exceeds 1,000; mark query failed and do not materialize candidates

source.revision: finalized capture-manifest SHA-256 binding API version, frozen query document, request metadata, and every raw response hash

source_record_identity.record_unit: one search result item; issue relation and PR-detail responses are hashed supporting artifacts
source_record_identity.source_record_order: query_id, then page number, then item index for presentation only; ID is content-addressed
